key_fields.name: DALYTRAN-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 350-byte daily (unposted) transaction record (comment RECLN 350; field sizes add up to 350).

key_fields.name: DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Card number; CBTRN01C verifies it against the card cross-reference.

observations.text: Field-for-field identical to CVTRA05Y apart from the DALYTRAN- prefix; the daily and posted transaction layouts are maintained as two separate copybooks.

purpose: CVTRA06Y defines DALYTRAN-RECORD, the 350-byte daily transaction input record with the same fields as the posted transaction (CVTRA05Y). It is read from the sequential DALYTRAN file by CBTRN01C (verification) and CBTRN02C (posting).
